{"path":"neuron_growth_anthropic-claude-haiku-5-5_01.html","edit_description":"Create a NEW single self-contained HTML file (HTML + CSS + vanilla JS, one file, no images/textures). The only external resource allowed is dat.gui, loaded via <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dat.gui@0.7.9/build/dat.gui.min.js"></script>. Do not mention any game, movie, brand or copyrighted style anywhere in code or comments.

PAGE/CSS: body background #05070f, margin 0, min-height 100vh, flex centered. One <canvas id="c" width="800" height="800"> styled 800x800 (max-width:100vw; height:auto) centered. Add a faint radial glow behind the canvas using background: radial-gradient(circle at center, #101a3a 0%, #05070f 70%). Vignette: wrap canvas in a div with a pseudo-element radial-gradient(transparent 55%, rgba(0,0,0,0.85)) overlay, pointer-events none. Keep dat.gui panel at default top-right.

PALETTE (exact): BG #05070f, BG_GLOW #101a3a, BRANCH #00e5ff, ACCENT_BRANCH #d6ff00, SYNAPSE #ff2bd6, PULSE #fff36a, UI #ffd400, GRID rgba(0,229,255,0.08).

JS STRUCTURE with short comments per section: 1) SETUP (canvas, ctx, constants, config object), 2) GUI SETUP, 3) NEURON GROWTH, 4) SYNAPSE DETECTION, 5) PULSE ANIMATION, 6) RENDERING, then requestAnimationFrame main loop with delta time. Use camelCase names.

CONFIG (controlled by dat.gui, use gui.add with min/max/step):
Folder "Growth": neuronCount (3-6 int, default 4) -> seed neuron count; branchGrowthSpeed (0.5-6, default 2) px per frame; maxBranchDepth (2-7, default 5); branchSplitChance (0-0.6, default 0.25); branchCurvature (0-0.6, default 0.25); maxBranchLength (20-160, default 90); plus buttons regenerateNetwork, clearCanvas, pauseResume (toggle label "Pause"/"Resume" via controller name).
Folder "Synapses": synapseDistanceThreshold (10-120, default 45); synapseGlowStrength (0-30, default 14) used as shadowBlur.
Folder "Pulses": pulseSpeed (0.005-0.05, default 0.02) progress per frame; pulseFrequency (0-1, default 0.3) chance per frame to spawn a pulse; pulseBrightness (0.2-2, default 1) alpha/shadowBlur multiplier.
Folder "Visuals": backgroundColor (#05070f), branchColor (#00e5ff), accentBranchColor (#d6ff00), synapseColor (#ff2bd6), pulseColor (#fff36a) as color controls; use addColor; also optional showGrid boolean (scanlines rgba(0,229,255,0.08)).

Also a folder-level setting: changing neuronCount/maxBranchDepth/etc. does not auto-regenerate; regenerateNetwork button does.

NEURON GROWTH: neurons = [{x,y}] seeds placed randomly within ~150px of center (400,400), count = neuronCount (3-6). Each seed starts a root branch object {x,y,angle,depth,length:0,maxLen,width,parent,done,points:[{x,y}]}. Branch objects stored in flat array `branches`. Each frame each growing branch advances by branchGrowthSpeed along angle with small random angle jitter (organic curve: angle += (rand-0.5)*branchCurvature; smooth by blending angle toward previous average), records points. Stop branch when length >= maxLen (randomized per branch around maxBranchLength*(0.6..1)) or out of canvas. When branch finishes and depth < maxBranchDepth, spawn 1-2 children at +/- angles (~0.5 rad) with probability branchSplitChance; also occasionally (10%) spawn a small side branch with shorter maxLen. Total branch cap MAX_BRANCHES = 400 and growth stops when all branches done (stable size). Branch width = 1.2 + random*0.6 (slight variation), decreasing with depth.

RENDERING of branch: draw each branch as quadratic curve through points using ctx.quadraticCurveTo with midpoints (lightweight smoothing), stroke with branchColor, lineWidth = width, shadowBlur = 6, shadowColor = branchColor. Children from depth odd use accentBranchColor for variety. Neuron seed: draw filled circle radius 4 with bright white-ish core and shadowBlur 16 of branchColor.

SYNAPSES: every ~10 frames (not every frame), compare branch tip points (last point of each branch, plus points sampled every few entries) across different branches (skip same branch and parent-child immediate). If distance < synapseDistanceThreshold, create synapse {a:pointA,b:pointB,pulse:0,key} only if key `${min}_${max}` not in Set of existing keys (use string key built from branch ids and point indices to prevent duplicates). Cap synapses at 300. Synapses drawn as line with synapseColor, shadowBlur = synapseGlowStrength, global composite 'lighter', alpha slowly pulsing sin(time) between 0.5 and 1.0; synapse line lineWidth 1.2 and brighter than branches.

PULSES: array `pulses` each {synapse, t:0, dir}. Each frame with probability pulseFrequency spawn a pulse on a random synapse (if any). Advance t += pulseSpeed; t>=1 remove. Position = lerp(a,b,t) with smoothstep easing. Draw as small spark: a bright core circle radius 2.5 fill pulseColor with shadowBlur = 18*pulseBrightness, plus 2-3 short trailing line segments with decreasing alpha behind the head (trail points from lerp at t-0.05, t-0.1). Also flash the synapse while pulse passes (alpha boost). Also every ~90 frames activate a random path: when network stopped growing, keep pulses flowing forever so scene stays alive.

BACKGROUND: each frame fill rect with backgroundColor, then a radial gradient glow from BG_GLOW #101a3a at center. Draw scanline grid: horizontal lines every 4px with rgba(0,229,255,0.08) only if showGrid, plus a very faint random noise dots (~60 per frame, rgba(255,255,255,0.04)) for grit. Use ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter' for glowing parts, reset to 'source-over' after.

PAUSE: paused flag; when paused skip updates but still render (or stop updating time). Button toggles paused and updates label. CLEAR CANVAS: empties branches, synapses, pulses, and fills background. REGENERATE: resets everything and generates new seed neurons and branches. Use requestAnimationFrame loop with timestamp delta clamped to 50ms. Keep code compact (~250-350 lines total). No external libraries other than dat.gui. Ensure gui.destroy is not needed. Make sure the file is valid and fully self-contained."}
